title: Cafe requests a third revision round
brief:
Client: Tansy Cup Cafe; contact robin@example.com.
Design one A4 breakfast menu, one side only.
Supply the menu as a print PDF and a web JPEG.
Two revision rounds cover colour, spacing and text-size tweaks to the menu; further rounds are billed at the rate card.
Initial proof is due 20 October; final files are due 26 October.
Out of scope: new menu pages, photography and translation.
message: I know we have used both revision rounds. Please change the breakfast menu heading colour to dark green. That is the only tweak this time.
